title: Writing Simple Sentences
introduction: Practise writing simple sentences with familiar words and short sentences.
definition: A simple sentence can tell who or what it is about and what happens or what it is like.
rules: Start with a person or thing, then say something about it.
Use a capital letter, spaces and suitable punctuation.
Write two sentences about a favourite toy in your notebook.

grammar.description: A person or thing and an action.

examples.question: Put in order: like / I / rice
steps: Start with a person or thing, then say something about it.

examples.question: Put in order: is / It / red
steps: Use a capital letter, spaces and suitable punctuation.

exercises.question: Put in order: like / I / rice
Put in order: is / It / red
